requires_build.runs: the code of this project's packages

backends.safety: languageserver runs inside an R session that loads the namespaces of the project's dependencies (asNamespace runs each package's .onLoad and loads its DLLs) and of packages named in library()/require() calls, so R always needs trace index --allow-build. The session never reads the project's .Rprofile / .Renviron (--no-init-file --no-environ; R_PROFILE_USER / R_ENVIRON_USER are empty files in the state dir, which also covers languageserver's callr workers), diagnostics are off so lintr never evaluates .lintr, and temporary files (the deparsed package functions) go to the state dir. The server and its 41 dependencies are BINARY packages from the dated Posit Package Manager snapshot 2026-09-25 (sha256 of every file per platform, Linux distro and R minor recorded at pin time; no compiler, no Rtools), installed with the user's R into the tools folder per R minor. Pinned: Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 + x86_64, Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu noble/jammy, RHEL 9) and aarch64 (noble), R 4.5 and 4.6; Debian bookworm and aarch64 jammy were dropped because the snapshot had no binaries for every package.
